name: What factors should I consider when designing a multigenerational home addition?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when designing a multigenerational home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When designing a multigenerational addition, consider accessibility features like wider doorways, zero-entry showers, and ramps for future needs. Think about the level of independence desired, which dictates whether to include a full kitchen or just a kitchenette. Privacy is key, so consider separate entrances and soundproofing. Integrate common areas for family gatherings. Also, consider the long-term flexibility of the space, allowing it to adapt if family needs change. Energy efficiency and natural light should also be prioritized for comfort and lower utility costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider accessibility, level of independence, privacy, common areas, long-term flexibility, and energy efficiency when designing a multigenerational addition.
